data.exact_reserve_text: In 2017, there has been an overall deficit of GBP 4.9m on prior year reserves (2016 deficit of GBP 2.3m). The deficit is primarily driven by premium reductions and reserve increases on the marine and energy classes of business.

named_events.loss_description: The Syndicate has material exposure to the Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria ("HIM") in the 2016 and 2017 year of account; a 5% increase in Gross (Net) HIM reserves would result in a GBP 1.7m (GBP 0.1m) increase.

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2017 the Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding were GBP 110.206m. Using the gross claims development triangle, prior year development (excluding the two most recent underwriting years) shows a net adverse movement (strengthening) of approximately GBP 7.03m (6.4% of opening gross claims), largely driven by adverse development on older years. The managing agent notes an overall prior year deficit (net) of GBP 4.9m and attributes the deterioration primarily to premium reductions and reserve increases in the marine and energy classes. The syndicate also reports material exposure to Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria in the 2016 and 2017 years of account.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development used here is calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross cumulative claims incurred by underwriting year) because the technical provisions movement line includes current year movements and the narrative quoted a net prior year deficit (GBP 4.9m) which appears to be a net (after reinsurance) figure. The triangle-derived gross PYD is ~GBP 7.03m (strengthening) while the report narrative cites a net deficit of GBP 4.9m. All source amounts in the accounts are presented in GBP '000; this extraction converts to millions. Amounts for LOB-specific reserve movements are not quantified in the report and are therefore null.
